scope: Stopped startup-gate validation and bounded right-gripper breakaway characterization; no arm movement qualification.
interpretation: Positive direction met the finite trial criteria; negative direction moved but failed the post-stop speed envelope. Neither is a repeatability or jaw-force calibration.
Raw trace peak reverse speed is 0.254292 rad/s including final cleanup, greater than the older per-ramp summary of 0.229114. Historical raw output is preserved unchanged.

Encoder reversal after removing torque is consistent with elastic recoil/backlash. Stopped telemetry also varies; mechanism dynamics and estimator noise remain unseparated. No bound was relaxed and no further powered trial was run.

Final binary adds explicit final-stop feedback and includes it in breakaway maxima/pass criteria. It passed regression tests and Linux launch validation; it was not used to repeat these powered trials. Guarded controller binary is unchanged from the tested startup/benchmark artifact.

Only left j4/j5 and right gripper have volatile watchdog=600 at final inspection; the other eleven read zero. All 14 current-firmware individual behavior passes remain historical qualification, not active watchdog configuration.
No physical CAN-loss/host-crash loaded stop, synchronized arms, motor-to-CAD calibration, or full collision/camera loop acceptance is claimed.
